note: Private RV resort at Folding Mountain on Hwy 16, about 5 km east of the Jasper National Park gate and 18 km west of Hinton, with large treed sites, security lighting, cabins, motel rooms and rental trailers. --Claude
summary: Rates now C$68 base / C$72 (50 A) from the ResNexus engine (stale C$44/60.50 dropped); 100 stalls, 50 A, max 44 ft, long-weekend 3-night minimum, 2027 season May 8 - Oct 15 from the engine calendar; private gates pass.
